# Lead and signal routes that stay on FastAPI (plan 05, decision D1 + constraints.md). One "METHOD /path/{param}" per line.
# Go must not register them; infra/nginx/go-routes.conf keeps them on api_backend at every canary percentage.
# 7 routes: enrich, search/unified and scraper/scrape (plan 14 keeps them on Python too, retained_leadgen_routes.txt),
# the 3 legacy workspace_router routes (NOT mounted by main.py: the canonical /api/workspaces is ws_manager_router,
# served by plan 02) and the signal source registry.
# The 14 routes this file originally listed for the Python SQLite job ledger and @limiter helpers (POST /api/collect,
# GET/POST/DELETE /api/jobs*, GET /api/system-stats, POST /api/leads/{verify-email,score,tech-stack,domain-intel}) were
# ported to Go by plan 14; TestEveryPythonLeadSignalRouteIsPortedOrRetained accepts them as ported (leadgenGoPatterns).

GET /api/workspaces
